resolution.summary: Live experiment completed: existing account-bound OpenCut ChatGPT OAuth, no Platform API key, one synthetic Hebrew mono24kHz WAV (4.9488s,241638bytes) sent to https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/transcribe. HTTP403 returned in714ms with text/html and cf-mitigated:challenge; no transcript or JSON. This is a Cloudflare transport block, not evidence of insufficient credits or unsupported account entitlement. Billing and word timestamps remain undetermined. Secrets stayed server-side, no project media uploaded and no protection bypass attempted. Temporary diagnostic route removed and HTTP404 verified. Sanitized result and screenshot saved in .local/codex-transcription-research/live-probe-result.json and live-probe-result.png. No permanent product changes.
